component.name: bibli
component.summary: Browse, find and organize your files

description.p: bibli is an experimental file manager, drawn by the GPU, built to be driven by people, scripts and agents alike.

ul.li: Lists, grids and columns that stay responsive on very large folders
Previews of documents, pictures, music, films, archives and maps
Tags kept on the files themselves, where other applications find them
Every change undoable, and planned for review before it is applied
